baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, interspace, front, and rear form an access map. What lacks truth or stability is denied every mapped approach, so the claim concerns failed ingress rather than only an abstract truth predicate.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching supply the attempted access event that the negation blocks.
Departure from truth and stability identifies the excluded entrant.
The interval between parties supplies an approach corridor rather than a free-floating direction.
What lies before or close ahead supplies the forward face of the access map.
What lies behind supplies the rear face and completes the spatial closure.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood is simply absent from the Book.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood is figured as an entrant that cannot obtain a route to the Book from any side.

baseline_models.mechanism: The front can carry what precedes, while khalf can carry succession, divergent paths, and later corruption. With bāṭil as invalidation or removal, the two directions extend into a temporal claim: neither antecedent material nor a later successor, dispute, or alteration can displace the revelation.

activation_trace.role: Making something void or removing it supplies the threatened operation, not merely false content.
The advanced or preceding position opens the earlier side of the temporal span.
A successor arriving after another supplies later replacement as a possible but excluded threat.
Taking a contrary path supplies later disagreement or contradiction.
Change into corruption supplies the strongest alteration image within the rearward term.

changed_reading.before: The front and rear are only two physical directions.
changed_reading.after: The denial also spans what precedes and what follows: no earlier claim or later replacement, contradiction, or decay can void the revelation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing source construction explains the no-entry claim. The revelation is deliberately put in its fitting rank by one whose wisdom prevents corruption and perfects construction, with an outcome found praiseworthy; immunity is therefore authored integrity rather than accidental isolation.

activation_trace.role: Invalidation and removal name the failure that the source design prevents.
Putting a thing in its proper station supplies deliberate ordering to tanzil.
Preventive restraint for reform supplies active exclusion of corruption.
Tight, perfected construction supplies internal integrity.
Being found praiseworthy after experience supplies tested rather than merely asserted worth.

changed_reading.before: Wise and Praiseworthy merely identify the sender after the protection claim.
changed_reading.after: The source titles causally seal the claim: ordered placement, preventive wisdom, perfected construction, and tested praise explain why invalidation gains no entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Detailed separation at the surah's opening and eventual clarification as truth at its close turn the boundary against bāṭil into a disclosed, inspectable distinction. The revelation does not merely repel an enemy; its articulation makes the truth/falsehood boundary visible.

activation_trace.role: Lack of truth and stability supplies the side of the distinction denied access.
Separating things until their boundary appears supplies visible discrimination.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the textual means by which the boundary is exposed.
Becoming manifest and clear turns bayn from interval into disclosed truth.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the positive pole opposed to bāṭil.

structural_cues: 41:3 describes the Book's signs as detailed; 41:53 says the signs continue until it becomes clear that it is the truth.
The focus places bāṭil between those two disclosure statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies detailing, visible separation, clarification, and stable truth; I infer that disclosure helps police the boundary. A live alternative is that these are corroborating effects, not the cause of the no-entry claim.

changed_reading.before: The Book is protected by a closed boundary.
changed_reading.after: Its boundary is also epistemically open to inspection: detailed signs expose truth so that bāṭil cannot pass as an indistinguishable component.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly locates obstruction in hearers: ear-weight, a declared interpersonal barrier, deliberate noisy speech, and distant calling. Those attacks can block or distort reception while failing to become part of the revelation, sharply limiting the focus claim to integrity of source and transmission rather than guaranteed uptake.

activation_trace.role: Corrupting or voiding the thing itself supplies the operation denied at the textual layer.
Weight in the ear supplies a receiver-side blockage.
Prevention of access supplies the hearers' self-declared barrier rather than a defect in the message.
Mixed clamor supplies the deliberate interference placed around the recitation.
Overpowering force supplies the attackers' intended effect on the listening event.
Repeated ear-weight confirms that obstruction persists at reception even after the no-entry claim.

structural_cues: 41:5 places the barrier between speakers and hearers, 41:26 commands noise around the Qur'an, and 41:44 returns the weight to unbelievers' ears.
All three reception failures coexist with 41:42's categorical denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receiver-local barriers and attempted acoustic domination alongside denial of bāṭil's access; I infer a layer boundary between revelation and reception. A live alternative is that 41:42 also promises broader preservation without specifying a technical layer model.

changed_reading.before: If falsehood cannot approach, the message should suffer no obstruction or distortion in practice.
changed_reading.after: The revelation can remain unvoided while hearers block, drown out, or misperceive it; immunity of the Book is not immunity of every reception event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact fore-and-aft corridor appears at 41:14 as the route by which messengers came. Reused at the focus, it is not a wall against all arrival but a discriminating passage: truthful commissioned arrival traverses it, while bāṭil cannot.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at the Book supplies the focus-side access event.
Truthless instability identifies what the corridor excludes.
Actual coming and arrival show that the same corridor can carry a valid messenger.
The shared interval phrase makes the two route descriptions directly comparable.
The same front or preceding position supplies the admitted face of messenger arrival.
The same rear position completes the admitted messenger route.

structural_cues: 41:14 and 41:42 share the sequence min bayni aydihim/hi wa-min khalfihim/hi with an arrival verb.
The arriving subject changes from messengers to bāṭil, and the polarity changes from accomplished arrival to categorical nonarrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-formulaic route with opposite subjects and polarity; I infer selective permeability governed by the entrant's character. A live alternative is that both phrases independently express comprehensiveness without a corridor contrast.

changed_reading.before: The fore-and-aft phrase depicts a Book sealed from every approach.
changed_reading.after: The route is selectively open: commissioned truth can come through the same fore-and-aft field from which bāṭil is excluded.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 41:25 companions beautify what lies before people and behind them. The same coordinates are therefore a manipulable human horizon but an impermeable textual horizon: false framing can recolor a person's anticipated and inherited field without entering the revelation itself.

activation_trace.role: False claims without reality supply the content that can be made attractive around people but not admitted to the Book.
A companion bound to another supplies the social agent that frames the surrounding field.
Displaying or manufacturing beauty supplies the mechanism of deceptive reframing.
The interval locates the reframing in the person's surrounding field.
What lies ahead supplies the anticipated or forward portion that companions beautify.
What succeeds or remains behind supplies the inherited or trailing portion of the framed horizon.

structural_cues: 41:25 and 41:42 repeat ma/min bayna aydihim/hi wa-ma/min khalfahum/hi.
The earlier phrase is the object of beautification around people; the focus phrase is the route denied to bāṭil around the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companions, manufactured attractiveness, and the repeated fore/behind coordinates; I infer an asymmetry between a person's interpretive horizon and the Book's integrity. A live alternative is that 41:25 refers more narrowly to deeds or worldly matters.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only a protected object.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes a contrast: human past/future framing can be beautified by false companions even though the revelation they frame cannot itself absorb bāṭil.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately antecedent kitab aziz supplies a material-functional explanation for 41:42. A book joins parts into a written whole, while izz carries difficult access and solid cohesion; the following no-entry clause reads as the behavior of an integrated, resistant composition.

activation_trace.role: Unstable unreality supplies what fails to join the resilient whole.
Placing each thing in its station supplies ordered internal arrangement.
Perfected, tight construction supplies the focus-side cohesion.
Joining one thing to another supplies the assembled integrity of kitab.
Rarity and difficulty of access supply resistance to hostile approach.
Hardness and cohesion supply structural resilience rather than only honorific rank.

structural_cues: 41:41 ends with la-kitabun aziz, and 41:42 immediately predicates nonarrival of bāṭil of that Book.
The focus closes with hakim, whose branch inventory independently supplies perfected construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, difficult access, solidity, and perfected construction; I infer that these jointly explain resistance to bāṭil. A live alternative is that aziz marks exalted status or power without a compositional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No falsehood approaches because the Book has external protection.
changed_reading.after: The preceding kitab aziz and closing hakim make resistance an internal property of an assembled, tightly ordered, hard-to-penetrate composition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby book can become the object of disagreement, doubt, and unease without those states being equated with content entering the book. This sharpens the temporal baseline: later khilāf may proliferate around revelation while the focus denies successful invalidation of revelation.

activation_trace.role: Voiding or corrupting the object supplies the stronger operation that remains denied.
Divergent paths supply the possible later dispute already latent in the rearward term.
The written Book supplies the stable object about which the subsequent states gather.
Explicit disagreement in relation to the Book supplies an external reception history.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty locate instability in the disputants.
Agitated suspicion supplies the affective state surrounding, not constituting, the written object.

structural_cues: 41:45 says Moses was given the Book, then uses fihi for the disagreement and minhu for the doubt.
This historical parallel follows shortly after 41:42 and keeps book, dispute, and disputants grammatically distinguishable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a book plus disagreement and doubt directed toward it; I infer that controversy can remain external to textual integrity. A live alternative is that the historical parallel warns only about delayed judgment and does not define 41:42's boundary.

changed_reading.before: No later contradiction means no serious disagreement can arise after revelation.
changed_reading.after: Later disagreement and doubt may surround a book; the stronger claim is that they do not thereby become valid content that voids or replaces it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps textual integrity into hydrology. It remains anchored in the focus branches for an access watercourse, a foreign flood, and descent, and 41:39 activates the image with delivered water and resulting growth. Render it only as a material analogy, not as a lexical translation of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse and the directing of its flow supply the controlled channel.
A flood arriving from another land supplies the intrusive off-source flow identified with bāṭil.
Descent and settling supply the genuine downward flow of revelation.
Delivering water by pouring supplies the whole-surah material activator for directed descent.
Earth and plant stirring into life supply the productive effect of the admitted flow.
Nourishment and growth complete the contrast between life-giving descent and intrusive flood.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood cannot travel to the revelation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, revelation is a life-giving directed flow whose channel will not admit an alien flood of bāṭil.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bāṭil's branch of blood or liability going void and reads the ayah forensically. It remains anchored in bāṭil and hakim and is activated by bodily testimony and recompense in the surah. Downstream prose should mark it as a forensic resonance, not the governing sense of bāṭil.

activation_trace.role: Blood going unavenged or uncompensated supplies the image of a claim or wrong being allowed to lapse.
Just adjudication supplies the forum in which lapse or voiding is prevented.
A praiseworthy endpoint supplies the just completion of the record.
Evidence stated with knowledge supplies the surah's forensic testimony.
A sign that speaks or indicates supplies testimony even from embodied evidence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies nonlapse of consequence.

changed_reading.before: The Book cannot contain false propositions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a nonvoidable record under wise judgment: testimony and consequence cannot be made to disappear without resolution.

strongest_changes: 41:14 reuses the fore-and-aft corridor for messengers, making 41:42 selectively permeable to truthful arrival rather than sealed against all arrival.
41:5, 41:26, and 41:44 separate protected textual integrity from vulnerable human hearing and reception.
41:25 makes the same fore-and-aft field manipulable around people but closed to bāṭil around the Book.
The immediately antecedent kitab aziz recasts nonarrival as the behavior of an integrated, hard-to-penetrate composition.
41:45 permits later disagreement and doubt around a book without equating them with invalidation inside it.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly redeployed the focus's rare spatial grammar around messengers, manipulated human horizons, and contested reception. Those repetitions changed a generic preservation statement into a selective boundary model that distinguishes admitted truth, protected composition, and vulnerable readers.
remaining_uncertainties: The fore-and-aft phrase may be primarily spatial totality rather than a temporal reference to prior and later material.
Aziz may describe exalted status or power without implying compositional hardness or difficult access.
The hydrological and forensic readings are branch-led analogies and should remain exploratory.
